invariants.rationale: The result is obtained via collect(toList()), which never returns null.
If data is null, the result may be empty; otherwise, result.size() is always non-negative.
If data is null, data.stream() would throw; but as a 'just in case', result must be empty if data is null.
Assuming that func never produces nulls; flatMap and collect do not introduce nulls on their own.
The output cannot be larger than the number of inputs times the theoretical maximum output per input.
